//: Typechecks the test suite. The root tsconfig is a solution-style project (files: [] referencing package projects only), so nothing ever typechecked tests - which left the compile-time half of guards like `Record<keyof ExpertOutcome, unknown>` and the EVENT_KIND_COVERAGE Record inert. Extends tsconfig.base.json deliberately: the suite must face the project's real strictness (noUncheckedIndexedAccess, verbatimModuleSyntax), not a softer copy of it.
